weeklyPlan.focus: When to fine-tune, and the dataset
weeklyPlan.buildTask: Project c413: collect and anonymise DM threads, write the cleaning rules, and reach 200 chat-format examples with a train/eval split.
weeklyPlan.pythonTask: 20 min daily: write the JSONL validator and the dedupe and fixed-seed split functions, and run them on your dataset.

weeklyPlan.buildTask: Finish the dataset (c413) and write a baseline: run 20 eval prompts through a well-prompted base model and save the replies.
weeklyPlan.pythonTask: 20 min daily: LoRA parameter calculator, then compute the numbers for the model you plan to tune.

weeklyPlan.focus: Training stack and the first LoRA run
weeklyPlan.buildTask: Project c414: pick one training stack (c407, c408 or c409), fine-tune a small open model in free Colab, and compare it with the baseline on your eval split.
weeklyPlan.pythonTask: 20 min daily: a small eval script that scores replies (format checks, length, exact match) and prints a comparison table.

weeklyPlan.focus: Quantization, serving and optional preference tuning
weeklyPlan.buildTask: Optional project c415: merge, convert to GGUF, serve locally and rerun the eval on fp16 and 4-bit. If short on time, read c411 and c412 instead.
weeklyPlan.pythonTask: 20 min daily: int8 quantize and dequantize with max error, then check how error grows with outliers.
